caption:
Mortgage rates jumped again. 🏠
Freddie Mac's 30-year average hit 7.28% on Nov. 19, up from 7.11% the week before and 6.26% a year ago.
On a $300,000 loan, that gap is roughly $200 more per month in principal and interest.
Are you waiting, buying, or renting for now?
first_comment: Be honest: what rate would make you actually buy a home? 👇
